payload.friendly_name: Round-trip pack.md through the markdown content form
payload.purpose_context: Issue #260, split from #195 under epic #186: the pack's Markdown description is the last pack-level file the whole-pack round-trip gate lists as other:pack.md. #194's first PR built the markdown content form (MarkdownDocument, MarkdownCodec); this mission uses that form to hold pack.md in the Pack aggregate, write it in WholePackStore, cover it in the source fingerprint between the presets and pack-manifest.yaml (ADR-0043 decision 9) and model it in the gate as pack-document.
payload.purpose_tldr: Each pack's pack.md is read into the Pack aggregate as a Markdown document and written back with the same meaning, so the whole-pack gate goes green on it.
